response.rationale: Both forms are valid for the narrowed maintenance sense. Indonesian pemeliharaan directly covers maintaining equipment or durable facilities; Malaysian penyelenggaraan also means maintaining buildings, vehicles, and similar items. Penyenggaraan may be more technically preferred for equipment in Malaysian usage, but penyelenggaraan remains acceptable. No false-friend contrast is asserted.
